items.title: Narrowband mixer opens with every channel weight at 0.00, i.e. a palette that renders black
items.reasoning: Both claimed causes are present in the file and are the real mechanism. narrowband_mixer_panel.dart:119 keys didUpdateWidget off _channelKeys() ('masterId:filter'), not length, so the async master arrival re-seeds instead of zeroing; :168 _presetApplies uses preset.filterToRgb.keys.every(available.contains) (full coverage, not .any), which is what makes Ha+OIII land on HOO rather than a red-less SHO; :142 the no-preset floor seeds [1,1,1] per channel labelled 'custom'. Preset order (SHO before HOO) means a full Ha/OIII/SII set still gets SHO, so the fallback cannot pre-empt a real palette. Production wiring is live: workbench_view.dart:301 builds the panel from controller.narrowbandChannels(), which sets label to the raw filter string ('Ha 7nm'), and _canon normalises that. Not a disclosure or a relocation -- the matrix the operator sees is different.
items.evidence: Severed the wiring, not the logic: replaced the _channelKeys re-seed in didUpdateWidget with the old length-guard + zero matrix. All 4 tests in narrowband_mixer_seed_test.dart went red ('Found 0 widgets with text "SHO preset"', 'Expected: [1,1,1] Actual: [0.0,0.0,0.0]'). Restored, all green. The tests read the RENDERED combine matrix text, not the private state, so they cannot pass on a panel that displays zeros. Full test/screens/session_review/ + the narrowband golden run 84/84 green after restore; the two goldens the run rewrote are byte-identical to HEAD (git status clean for them).
